description.name: Entry
description.text:
Grants Max HP +2000 to party, grants Master Mode, [Instant ATB 1], Starry Resplendence to user
Master Mode: Cap Break Level 1, Zero SB Cost 1 & Instant SB/LB Cast 1
Starry Resplendence: [Damage] or [Wind Damage] +5% to party if user has/does not have Realm Synergy
Interval Chase: [10 single-target Prismatic/NE white magic attacks] or [Single-target minor DeShell for 5 seconds] & [Damage] or [Wind Damage] +10/15/20/25/30% to party after 1/2/3/4/5 chases if user has/does not have Realm Synergy (max 5 chases)
Master Chase: Single-target Prismatic/NE piercing white magic attack at True Cap Break Level 1, Instant Cast 1 to party & Quick ATB 1 to En-Wind members, removes Master Mode

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999
